tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// mngon rtogs yan lag drug chung bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi pa dang*/ yan lag drug pa'i mngon par rtogs pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ 'byung ba bzhi lugs 'byung gi steng du bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo bhrūm̐ gyis mtshan pa dang bcas pa la/ rang gi sems oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho gnyis kyis mtha' brten par gyur pa 'dres pa las/ gzhal yas khang pa bskyed do// gzhal yas khang pa sku rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin du mos pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā nī la ya badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas gdan dbus ma'i steng du ā li gnyis las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa/ de'i steng du kā li ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha dang bcas pa gnyis las kyang zla ba'i dkyil 'khar gru gsum pa/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus nas gsum ka 'dres pa las rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po zhal g.yas sngo bar bskyed do// sangs rgyas thams cad zhal du zhugs/ snying gar zhu ba/ rdo rje'i lam nas bha gar 'phros pa thig le brgyad du gyur cing*/ de'ang lha mo brgyad du gyur nas rim pa bzhin du spros la/ gsal gdab par bya'o// rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bde ba chen po 'od du zhu nas thig ler gnas pa bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du mos pas/ oṃ sarba ta ga ta a nu rā ga ta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ dbang bskur nas dbu rgyan la rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab nas/ dbang bskur ba'i chu mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin du mos pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ gis byin gyis brlab bo// de nas bdud rtsi'am nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa lce la myangs pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi sku bdud rtsis gang zhing mnyes par bsgoms la/

bdud rtsi gsum gyi gnas lce dang*/ dpral ba mgrin par nyams su myangs pa 'od dpag tu med pa'i rang bzhin du mos pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas rang gi thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad spros pa dpag tu med par gyur nas rang gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la mchod par bsam zhing*/ dkar mos ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ la sogs pa brjod nas/ mchod pa phrin las don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin du mos pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mchod pa'i lha mo de dag nyid kyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la bstod par bsam zhing*/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs la sogs pa brjod nas bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin du mos pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas lha mo de rnams rang gi thugs kar bstim nas/ lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yid mnyam par gzhag go /khams drug yul drug dbang po drug /rnam shes drug dang nyon mongs drug /kha dog drug dang rigs drug dang*// phung po dbyings dang bcas pa drug /sbyangs nas rgyal ba rigs drug po// thob phyed yan lag drug pa yi// mngon par rtogs pa'i tshul 'di ni// rgyas bas rdo rje gur las gsungs// de yi lag tu blang ba'i tshul// rgyas par dam pas mdzad zin mod// blo gsal ba la tshig nyung bas// chog phyir bdag gis 'di bsdebs so// rgyal bu khyod mtshan lcags zhes bgyi// don yang lcags kyi khams ji bzhin// rin po che dang nyer mkho dang*// las su rung bar grub pa lags// de la 'di la sogs pa yi// dri med chos kyi gser 'gyur rtsis// reg pas rgyal ba'i gser bzangs su// 'gyur ba shin tu ngo mtshar lags// 'ga' yis tshig sbyor shes lags kyang*// don gyi cha la rnam par rmongs// don shes la la sdeb sbyor la// kun tu rmongs par gyur pa'ang gda'// gnyis ka'i cha la ma rmongs pa// gnyis kyis mos pa gsum pos yid// yid bzhin du ni tshim bgyid pa// ngo mtshar lags pas mkhyen par mdzod// yan lag drug pa'i mngon par rtogs pa rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa gsal bar brjod pa 'di ni/

mthong na mi mthun pa med cing*/ yid dga' ba'i dpal du gyur pa/ rgyal bu ji big de mur gyi don du dge slong sngags 'chang ba/ 'phags pa zhes bya bas/ sa pho 'brug gi lo/ ston zla 'bring po'i tshes nyi shu la/ bha phang gi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
